darkMassAudit.metric: percent of opaque pixels below luminance 60

contrastAudit.metric: opaque-pixel luminance percentile span across each 9-frame sheet
contrastAudit.outlinePolicy: Laura and Ronette use character-colored lower/right selective contours; upper/left edges remain open and chromatic

logLadyBackSilhouette.identityCues: pinched crown/shoulder rows, asymmetric shawl edge, warm carried-log ramp

widthDistribution.profilePolicy: profile archetypes target 13 px slender, 14 px sturdy/tall, and 15 px broad/compact; front and back volumes remain unchanged

evidence.motionProof: all 24 actors labeled across DOWN/UP/RIGHT/LEFT and IDLE/STEP-A/STEP-B; LEFT is deterministic nearest-neighbor mirror of RIGHT, matching runtime direction policy

visualNotes: Native-size silhouettes remain readable across front, back, and profile rows.

Top-left chromatic lighting and dark lower contours preserve selective-outline grammar without antialiasing.

Round 2 deepens Laura and Ronette midtones, separates BOB/Jacques/Log Lady materials, and unifies Jacoby's formerly fragmented garment colors.
Round 4 reserves the darkest ramp for silhouette and facial-feature edges; interior dark pixels become chromatic hair or garment clusters.
Round 4 adds character-specific collar and center-accent marks, keeping face, hands, shirt, jacket, and hair on separate perceived ramps.
Round 4 widens Cooper front/back views to 17 pixels while keeping intentional 13-pixel profiles.
Round 5 limits each perceived material ramp to three tones, removing continuous diagonal shading at native size.
Round 5 ranks outline tones by top-left light direction while reserving darkest pixels for lower/right contact and occlusion.
Round 5 adds one-pixel neck and waist cuts by body category, separating head and torso while preserving broad, slender, tall, and compact identities.
Round 7 widens only sub-13-pixel profiles to 13 pixels, leaving every front and back silhouette unchanged.
Round 7 moves stable top/left outline segments into character-colored hair or clothing ramps while retaining dark contact, occlusion, hands, and single-pixel gestures.
Round 7 guarantees a one-pixel face highlight and front torso accent where legal source pixels exist, preventing hair, face, and torso from collapsing into one value mass.
Round 8 restores one-pixel swept, wide, long-hair, and hat-brim signatures inside existing actor bounds, increasing identity without changing frame dimensions.
Round 8 lifts near-black hair midtones for Cooper, Hawk, and Benjamin Horne while preserving contact and occlusion anchors.
Round 8 evidence labels every cast member at native scale and documents all four directions across idle and two gait phases.
Round 9 profiles use slender, sturdy/tall, and broad/compact target widths, replacing the common narrow rig without altering front or back views.
Round 9 adds profile-only neck highlights, front-side torso midtones, and archetype shoulder/belly signatures while preserving dark-mass gains.
Round 9 motion evidence labels all 24 actors across four directions and three gait phases at native 1x and nearest-neighbor 6x.
Round 10 adds one-pixel crown, shoulder, coat-tail, waist, and stance signatures to the otherwise similar dark-haired male rigs while staying inside established frame bounds.
Round 10 redistributes the same restrained ramps into centered back planes and visible profile planes, adding volume without extra colors or dark mass.
Round 10 evidence repeats the complete labeled 24-actor, four-direction, three-phase proof at native 1x and nearest-neighbor 6x.
Round 11 alternates one-pixel arm, hip, and shoe edges between Step A and Step B while preserving the common row-23 foot baseline in all 216 frames.
Round 11 raises the weakest Step A/B alpha-mask difference from one pixel to nine pixels; back and profile poses receive the clearest alternation without vertical jitter.
Round 12 contact boards mirror the shared tapered 14x5 two-value runtime ellipse for all 24 actors while the production atlas remains shadow-free.
Round 11 portrait composition preserves the 256x192 native viewport at integer 1x on 390x844 and expands cabinet ornament panels until only 16px separates them from display and controls.
Round 12 deepens Laura's cool blue and Ronette's teal-slate identity ramps, then adds selective lower/right chromatic contours so pale characters remain readable on bright terrain.
Round 12 sculpts Log Lady's back with crown, shoulder, shawl, and carried-log asymmetry instead of a common oval mass.
Round 12 replaces cross-ramp back stripes with same-ramp hair sheen, centered shoulder yokes, and lower folds across the full cast; sheets remain shadow-free.
Round 12 evidence repeats the complete labeled 24-actor, four-direction, three-phase proof at native 1x and nearest-neighbor 6x.
